_readme: Salesforce B2C Commerce Cloud pack knowledge. Structural conventions (cartridges/, .project, app_storefront_base, modules/, the cartridge path, hooks, metadata XML) are STABLE and live in pack.json as_source.

The two lists below are SEED, not verified facts: assembled from general B2C Commerce knowledge. Re-verify per engagement against developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce for the project's compatibility mode and SFRA base version.

target_api_endpoint_families lists SCAPI family paths (Shopper and Admin/Data) plus the legacy OCAPI shapes. Resource VERSIONS (v1 / v2) and per-resource coverage change between releases and differ by licence (headless access is a separate entitlement), so treat every entry as 'check this family exists and covers the operation needed', never as coverage.

target_content_component_types mixes content assets, content slot configurations and Page Designer components/layouts. Standard Page Designer component names ship in the app_storefront_base cartridge and CHANGE BETWEEN SFRA RELEASES - verify each against the base cartridge of the target release before quoting it in a deliverable.
B2B note: everything here describes B2C Commerce. B2B Commerce is a separate product on the Salesforce Platform with a different API and content model entirely - do not mix the two lists.
target_api_endpoint_families: SCAPI Shopper: /shopper/products (product and variation details, product lists)
SCAPI Shopper: /shopper/search (product search with refinements and sorting, search suggestions)
SCAPI Shopper: /shopper/baskets (basket, items, shipments, shipping and billing address, payment instruments, coupons)
SCAPI Shopper: /shopper/orders (order creation from a basket, order lookup)
SCAPI Shopper: /shopper/customers (registration, profile, addresses, payment instruments, product lists, order history)
SCAPI Shopper: /shopper/login (SLAS - shopper JWT issuance, guest and registered flows, refresh; verify the current flow set)
SCAPI Shopper: /shopper/context (effective shopper context for pricing, promotions and segmentation - verify availability)
SCAPI Shopper: /shopper/stores (store locator and store details)
SCAPI Shopper: /shopper/experience (Page Designer pages and their component tree as JSON - the headless content contract)
SCAPI Shopper: /shopper/gift-certificates (gift certificate balance and redemption)
SCAPI Shopper: /shopper/promotions (promotion details by id or campaign)
SCAPI Shopper: /shopper/seo (URL mapping resolution for SEO-friendly paths - verify)
SCAPI Shopper: /shopper/discovery-search (Einstein-backed search - verify licence and availability)
SCAPI Custom APIs: /custom/<api-name>/<version> (project-defined endpoints implemented as cartridge hooks - the sanctioned way to close a coverage gap)
SCAPI Admin/Data: product (product master and variation data, product search in Data API terms)
SCAPI Admin/Data: catalog (catalogs, categories, category assignments, recommendations)
SCAPI Admin/Data: order (order search, order status and payment updates)
SCAPI Admin/Data: customer (customer lists, customers, customer groups, addresses)
SCAPI Admin/Data: promotion and coupon (promotions, coupons, coupon codes)
SCAPI Admin/Data: campaign (campaigns, promotion and slot assignments)
SCAPI Admin/Data: jobs (job execution and status - the entry point for import/export orchestration)
SCAPI Admin/Data: site and site preferences (site configuration, preference values)
SCAPI Admin/Data: custom objects (read/write of custom object instances - mind the storage quotas)
SCAPI Admin/Data: code versions and source-code groups (deployment automation)
SCAPI Admin/Data: inventory / assignments and gift certificates (verify which are SCAPI and which remain OCAPI-only)
Legacy OCAPI Shop API: /s/<site-id>/dw/shop/v<n>/<resource> (feature-frozen; verify which resources have no SCAPI successor yet)
Legacy OCAPI Data API: /s/-/dw/data/v<n>/<resource> (feature-frozen; still the only path for some admin resources - verify)
IMPEX WebDAV: /on/demandware.servlet/webdav/Sites/Impex/... - file-based bulk data interface consumed by Job Framework steps, not an HTTP API but often the real integration contract
Omnichannel Inventory and Salesforce Order Management have their own APIs outside SCAPI (separate products and licences - verify)
target_content_component_types: Content asset (dw.content.Content: library-scoped rich text with custom attributes; renders only where a template or slot includes it)
Content library and content folder classification (the asset's structure and navigation)
Content slot configuration: global context
Content slot configuration: category context
Content slot configuration: folder context
Content slot configuration: product context (recommendation and merchandising slots)
Content slot rendering template (the ISML template a slot configuration is bound to)
Page Designer page (experience/pages/*.json - the page type with its regions)
Page Designer layout / mobile grid layout (experience/layouts - the region grid a page is built from; e.g. one-row-one-column through multi-row grids, verify names per release)
Page Designer region and component group (the containers components are dropped into, with min/max and allowed-type rules)
Page Designer component: editorial rich text
Page Designer component: image, image and text, photo tile
Page Designer component: carousel
Page Designer component: product tile and product listing
Page Designer component: category tile and popular categories
Page Designer component: campaign or main banner
Page Designer component: video (hosted and external provider)
Page Designer component: Einstein recommendations (verify licence)
Custom Page Designer component (project-defined component.json plus render script and ISML - needs a frontend counterpart on a headless target or it does not render)
ISML template and local include (templates/default/** - the developer-level composition layer)
ISML remote include (its own request and its own cache entry - a performance and personalisation decision)
Message resource bundle (templates/resources/*.properties - path-resolved as whole files, not per key)
Page meta tag rule (SEO title, description and canonical generation per page type)
URL rule / SEO URL mapping (site URL configuration, verify how it surfaces through /shopper/seo)
Transactional email template (ISML mail templates rendered by controllers or jobs)

_stamp.source: seed from general platform knowledge, to be verified
